title: Utah State University
description: Utah State University's official brand toolkit defines the primary colours Aggie Blue (#0F2439), Fighting White (#FFFFFF), Gray (#A2AAAD) and Black (#000000), and the secondary colours Hunter Green (#124734), Sage Green (#6B9E85), Sky Blue (#288DC2), Electric Blue (#01ADD8), Watermelon (#F16278), Tangerine (#F58220), Sunflower (#F6BD17) and Sand (#D1CBBD).
